status: DRAFT — data downloaded and contract inspected (2026-09-08 morning); NOT frozen; no OlmoEarth S1 cache extracted yet; freeze before any decoder or updater run
why_this_task: First external test of the streaming-cache finding (MS-116) on a task whose label is the state AFTER a new observation: KuroSiwo flood masks describe the post-event image. A stale cache (pre-event only) cannot contain the flood; full re-encode with the post image can; the streaming updater must recover it from the single post-event embedding. This is the deployment story itself, not a proxy.

data.source: GEO-Bench-2 aialliance/kuro_siwo (geobench_kuro_siwo.tortilla, 7.1 GB, ALL FILES OK)
data.sample: 224x224 @10 m, EPSG:3857; S1 VV/VH linear backscatter (float32, median VV≈0.04), 3 dates pre_1, pre_2, post; DEM; mask classes No Data/No Water/Permanent Water/Flood; invalid_data mask

olmoearth_contract.units: OlmoEarth normalizer expects dB (computed.json: vv mean -11.65 sd 10.84, vh mean -17.75 sd 10.22) -> convert 10*log10(max(x,1e-6)) before input; document clip
olmoearth_contract.timestamps: only flood_date is given; post = flood_date, pre_2 = flood_date - 12 d, pre_1 = flood_date - 24 d (S1 revisit) — DECLARED approximation, sensitivity check with -6/-30 d
olmoearth_contract.crop: 224 -> 4x 112? No: keep the sealed 64-px crop contract: tile 224 = 3x3 crops of 64 with 16-px overlap discarded? -> DECISION PENDING; default: center 192x192 = 3x3 crops of 64 px, patch 4 -> 48x48 tokens; labels cropped identically
olmoearth_contract.dem: not fed to OlmoEarth (no DEM modality); DEM available to decoders as an extra channel ONLY if declared for all arms

arms.streaming_gru: state = window [pre_1, pre_2]; one GRU step with single-date embedding of post (updater trained on train split, closed loop irrelevant: 1 step)

decoder: one frozen decoder per seed trained on TEACHER embeddings of the train split (flood vs rest, or 3-class), selected on val; applied unchanged to every arm on test
grouping: generalization unit = activation (actid); report per-activation macro and overall; benchmark test split is the primary, leave-activation-out is a sensitivity

metrics.primary: exact AP of Flood on test
metrics.secondary: flood IoU@0.5, false-alarm rate on No Water pixels

screen_rule_proposed.pass: streaming_gru recovers >= 80% of (teacher - stale) flood AP with updater seed mean, and gru_noobs <= 20%, on the benchmark test split
screen_rule_proposed.fail: streaming_gru < 50%: streaming does not transfer to S1 flood; report
screen_rule_proposed.note: thresholds proposed from Sen12 dev (77-95%); freeze after one data audit, before extraction
